_note: SYNTHETIC. Northwind Mutual is a fictional insurer; every person, number and note below is invented for the LeakGate demo and benchmark. Phone numbers use the 555-01xx range reserved for fiction; card numbers are random Luhn-valid test values.

records.name: Maria Okonkwo-Reyes
records.adjuster_notes: Insured reports fourteen inches of water in the finished basement after the October 9 storm surge. Sump pump failed during the outage. Insured mentioned she is undergoing chemotherapy at Lynn Cancer Institute and needs expedited temporary housing. Prior 2023 roof claim was denied for late notice.

records.name: Desmond Achterberg
records.adjuster_notes: Unit owner disputes the association's master policy deductible split. Owner is a city council staffer and asked that the claim not be discussed with the HOA board. Windows on the east face cracked; interior drywall water damage.

records.name: Priya Venkataraman-Holt
records.adjuster_notes: Roof inspected by independent adjuster Kowalczyk; granule loss consistent with hail but contractor estimate looks inflated. Insured is going through a divorce and asked that correspondence go only to her personal email.

records.name: Tobias Lindqvist
records.adjuster_notes: Elderly insured lives alone; daughter Ingrid holds power of attorney. Mold remediation started before inspection, which may complicate coverage. Insured uses a wheelchair and the ground floor is uninhabitable.

records.name: Grace Nakashima
records.adjuster_notes: Burglary while insured was abroad. Police report JSO-26-551902 filed. Insured is a pharmacist and reported a stolen laptop containing work schedules.

records.name: Rafael Quintanilla-Moreau
records.adjuster_notes: Kitchen fire spread to second floor. Insured is an attorney and has retained counsel; claim is in litigation, so all external communication must go through legal. Reserve set under the Bluefin reserve model.
